{{Infobox character|name=Master Builder Roar|house=[[House Phoenix]]|role=Master builder; keeper of the bonfire|age=~44}}
'''Master Builder Roar''' lights the yearly bonfire and tears down the obsolete, and believes most sincerely of all in the doctrine: that to burn is to liberate. His conscience is clear. That is what makes people careful around him.
